verdict.rationale: Paxos documents that a business can hold balances in stablecoin rather than auto-converting to fiat (paxos-docs-13). It also shows institution onboarding with an approval decision (paxos-docs-6), stablecoin-funded accounts (paxos-docs-46), and mint/redeem between USD and stablecoins with 1:1 redeemability and reserve reporting (paxos-docs-8, -9, -42, -43). However, the evidence never states availability, supported geographies, or eligibility criteria behind the onboarding gate. Missing for 10: stated geographic availability, explicit eligibility/gating criteria, custodial account terms (segregation, custody legal structure), independent corroboration.
